footnote: AI illustrations, not real results. Individual results vary.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a pure white seamless paper backdrop, soft daylight from the upper left, a faint grey contact-shadow area on the right. Square 1080x1080. Keep the right 45% of the frame as an empty space, evenly lit, for a pack photo placed later, and keep the left half as a calm empty area for copy. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
headline: 5% Marula Oil moisturizer, AM & PM
caption: Marula Oil 5% Face Moisturizer: 5% is the Marula Oil strength stated on the page; use AM & PM. The two frames are AI illustrations, not results.
photography_needed: Real, consented, unretouched before/after photos from a documented study of this product (same person, light and framing), with the study's claim and duration on file.
layout_description: White canvas; BEFORE and AFTER frames stacked on the left (AI illustrations with the AI mark until real study photos replace them); the real pack on the right; headline names the active, strength and routine only.
frames_prompt: two equal side-by-side panels of the same Indian woman in her early 40s with medium-brown skin, identical close crop of the cheek, framing, angle and soft daylight from the upper left. Left panel: a few faint dry, dull patches near the cheek; right panel: the same area slightly smoother. The difference is small and realistic, never dramatic; skin keeps natural pores and texture.
adaptation_notes: Format #12 Before / after: kept the stacked labelled frames beside the pack. Dropped: the timed-result headline ('fades X in 15 days'), struck price, molecule callouts, spa props and any study stat on the image. The frames are small, realistic AI illustrations (reused dry-skin frames from the Vitamin B5 moisturizer ad) and carry the AI label; Severe and not exportable until real study photos replace them.
